extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel and significant contributors, following the specified sections (Identification, Education/Training, Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contribution to Science, Research Support) and a five-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere strictly to the provided biosketch format and the five-page maximum for each person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification information
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login); POSITION TITLE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, eRA Commons username (or equivalent credential), and current position title at the top of the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study. Start with baccalaureate and include subsequent training; add or remove rows as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain why the individual is well qualified to serve in the proposed role: summarize relevant expertise, leadership roles, transdisciplinary experience, prior related funding, specific relevant projects, mentorship experience, and pertinent collaborations. Use concrete examples (e.g., prior grants, funded centers, program leadership) to justify fit for the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List previous and current positions (with dates) and honors/awards. Include roles, institutions, and relevant dates to demonstrate career trajectory and recognitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize significant areas of research contribution, describing the focus/impact of each area and providing representative publications (full citations). Provide illustrative examples of major findings, books, trials, or influential papers. Include a link to the complete bibliography when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (Active and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support — Active Research Support; Completed Research Support (Various completed projects in the past three years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each grant/project list award dates, grant number, sponsor (e.g., NIH/NIA), project title, role on the project (e.g., PI, MPI, Co-I), and a concise description of the project's goals/objectives and the individual's responsibilities. Separate active support from completed support and indicate any pending administrative notes (e.g., no-cost extensions, award transfers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project-level description and role notation
rubrics_metrics.description: For individual project entries (e.g., R21CA224874, R01 AG054009), include the project title, brief goals/objectives, and Role: (e.g., Co-I).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When listing research support or project involvement, state the project’s goals and the individual's specific role (e.g., Co-I, MPI). Provide brief aims or objectives to clarify relevance to the biosketch-holder's expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting specifics for dates and entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Completion Date MM/YYYY and provide date ranges for research support (e.g., 07/01/2018-06/30/2020).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present dates in the specified MM/YYYY format for education/training and as month/day/year ranges for project periods. Maintain consistent, precise date formatting throughout the biosketch.
